description: Get full details for one server member: roles, effective permissions, account/join dates, bot flag, and current timeout status. Permissions come from the member's roles, server-wide: channel overwrites are not applied. The owner and Administrators list every flag. The permissions list ignores an active timeout, during which Discord keeps only View Channel and Read Message History. timedOutUntil can be a past date once a timeout has expired. To find a member by name use discord_search_members; to page through members use discord_list_members.

user_id.description: Discord user ID (snowflake) of the member.

name: discord_get_member_info
